On this page

Components Documentation ​

Detailed documentation for each component and template is maintained in individual files inside the components/ directory. Click any link below to open it.

Components ​

ComponentDescription
ActionsAction group for edit, delete, and info
ButtonVersatile button with variants, colors, and states
CalendarDate picker — single, range, or multiple
CardFlexible card with avatar, header slots, and color variants
CheckboxControlled/uncontrolled checkbox
ClockCircular clock for picking hours and minutes
ClockNumbersInternal clock numbers display (used by Clock)
DataTablePaginated data table with row actions
DateInputText input that opens a date picker
DropdownIcon-triggered dropdown menu
FileUploaderFile upload with type and size validation
IconButtonButton that renders a single icon
InputText input with multiple types and validation
InteractiveMapGoogle Maps location picker
LinkStyled anchor with primary/secondary variants
MenuContextual menu with configurable actions
ModalDialog with confirm/cancel actions
MultiSelectSelect multiple options from a list
SelectSelect a single option from a list
SidebarNavigation sidebar with icon support
TimeInputText input that opens a clock picker
WeekCalendar7-day calendar with categorized events
WeekCalendarRowSingle category row inside WeekCalendar

Templates ​

TemplateDescription
AppTemplateFull app layout with sidebar and top menu
FormTemplateForm layout with built-in submit button

General Usage ​

Importing Components ​

tsx
// Import a single component
import { Button } from "@neus-ui/components";

// Import multiple components
import { Button, Input, Checkbox, Modal } from "@neus-ui/components";

Importing Templates ​

tsx
import { AppTemplate, FormTemplate } from "@neus-ui/templates";
